status_values.INVESTIGATING: Evidence or cause is under investigation.
status_values.DEPLOYED: The fix is verified on its target deployment.
status_values.REACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: Targeted verification remains due after deployment.
status_values.CLOSED: Closure criteria are met and recorded.
status_values.WONT_FIX: The owner explicitly accepts leaving the issue as is.
status_values.REGRESSION: A previously closed defect has returned.

severity_values.P0: Catastrophic launch blocker, including serious exposure, corruption or broad critical unavailability.
severity_values.P1: Critical workflow broken or unsafe. Launch is blocked until resolved.
severity_values.P2: Important issue normally addressed before launch or before the affected milestone closes.
severity_values.P3: Lower-risk defect, polish or debt that may be scheduled later.

root_cause_status_values.SUSPECTED: Plausible explanation supported by incomplete evidence.
root_cause_status_values.CONFIRMED: Evidence demonstrates the causal mechanism for the stated scope.

metadata.evidence_taxonomy: Use metadata.evidence_levels from ACCEPTANCE_STATE.json. Evidence levels describe observations and are separate from source type.
metadata.links: Resolve acceptance_item_refs to item IDs in ACCEPTANCE_STATE.json. Resolve source_refs prefixed with acceptance: in its sources registry. Unprefixed refs resolve in this file. Legacy aliases identify the same finding. Related finding references preserve historical context without asserting equivalence.
metadata.scope: Record observed findings. Keep untested capabilities and setup debt in Acceptance State. Seed severities are scoped to the available impact evidence.
metadata.lifecycle: Keep IDs permanent. Append dated status/evidence transitions to history and regenerate summary counts after edits. Use null for unknown dates or revisions.
metadata.regression_rule: If a closed defect recurs, use the same ID, set status to REGRESSION and append the new evidence. Preserve prior closure and re-acceptance history.
metadata.closure_rule: For hosted defects, record the merged fix, verified deployed revision(s), successful targeted hosted re-acceptance and the absence of outstanding contradictory higher-quality evidence before closing. For local or CI defects use evidence appropriate to the original scope. Record result, provenance and why closure is valid.

step3.note: Agent Harness Step 3, section 11. Owner decisions and current diagnostic and staging observations.

findings.title: Inconsistent From price and CTA on mixed Free/Paid events
findings.summary: Public event surfaces disagreed about starting price and sometimes implied an RSVP-only event.
findings.expected_behavior: From equals the lowest currently available admission price, including zero. Mixed events retain discoverable paid tiers and a CTA that leads to ticket selection.
findings.observed_behavior: A mixed event showed conflicting price summaries and Event Detail could show RSVP for free despite paid tiers being available.
findings.owner_decision: Apply the lowest currently available admission rule on all event surfaces. Include Free and keep paid options visible.

remediation.summary: The frontend remediation is merged in #131; paired backend #202 is also merged. CI passed. Staging deployment and targeted hosted re-acceptance remain unverified.

reacceptance.scope: On staging compare Home, Explore, Search and Event Detail for free-only, paid-only and mixed tiers. Check active phases, unavailable or exhausted cheap tiers, From Free and access to paid choices.

history.note: Paired remediation merged into staging and CI passed. No staging deployment provenance or targeted hosted re-acceptance is recorded; finding remains open.

findings.title: Ended sale presented as temporary event unavailability
findings.summary: A valid event lifecycle outcome was rendered as a generic outage.
findings.expected_behavior: Render the actual sale or event state and close purchase/RSVP where applicable. Keep legitimate ended events accessible by direct URL, Search, Wallet History and existing historical profile/account surfaces where visibility permits. Upcoming Explore can omit them. Handle removed, private and moderated events separately.
findings.observed_behavior: The backend reported ended online sales while Event Detail displayed Event temporarily unavailable.
findings.root_cause: The reported shared API-client 409 boundary can lose the event_not_on_sale domain code. The referenced material does not trace that loss all the way to the observed render.
findings.owner_decision: Preserve visible historical events with closed admission and distinct access/visibility behavior.

remediation.summary: The paired remediation is merged in backend #202 and frontend #131. CI passed. Staging deployment and targeted hosted re-acceptance remain unverified.

reacceptance.scope: Verify upcoming, paused, sold-out and ended flows with precise messages, plus a genuine fetch failure. Follow ended-event links from Search, direct URL and Wallet History where permitted.

history.note: Paired remediation merged into staging and CI passed. No staging deployment provenance or targeted hosted re-acceptance is recorded; finding remains open.

findings.title: Explore and Search fail when discovery exceeds the render budget
findings.summary: Hosted Explore and Search produced a generic React Server Components failure.
findings.expected_behavior: Both pages render valid discovery data or present an actionable recoverable state if loading fails.
findings.observed_behavior: Hosted Explore and Search failed with React error #441 while Home/direct event entry remained reachable.
findings.root_cause: The owner reports a reproduced request where public discovery took about 5.17 seconds against a 4-second loader budget. The abort produced the generic React failure. This establishes the crash mechanism for that reproduction.

remediation.summary: The paired remediation is merged in backend #202 and frontend #131. CI passed. Staging deployment and targeted hosted re-acceptance remain unverified.

reacceptance.scope: On staging exercise both pages with representative data and filters. Verify slow or timed-out discovery produces a recoverable state without a generic React crash.

history.note: Paired remediation merged into staging and CI passed. No staging deployment provenance or targeted hosted re-acceptance is recorded; finding remains open.

findings.notes: Discovery latency needs separate performance evidence. A successful rendering retest establishes crash recovery only.

findings.title: Cancelled Free RSVP blocks a legitimate re-RSVP
findings.summary: The cancellation appeared in History, but a later claim restored no current admission.
findings.expected_behavior: An eligible Guest can claim again after cancellation, with one active entitlement, truthful cancellation history, correct capacity and idempotent retries.
findings.observed_behavior: Current Passes lost the cancelled RSVP and History showed it. One subsequent RSVP attempt reported already on the list, with no current pass restored.
findings.root_cause: The investigation implicates deterministic Guest/event RSVP identity and cancelled-state handling. The referenced material does not establish the exact branch or write that caused the result.

remediation.summary: The backend rebooking and frontend cancellation-route remediation are merged in #202 and #131. CI passed. Staging deployment and targeted hosted re-acceptance remain unverified.

reacceptance.scope: Run RSVP → cancel → re-RSVP. Verify exactly one active entitlement, truthful cancellation history, the expected capacity changes and safe repeat submissions.

history.note: Paired remediation merged into staging and CI passed. No staging deployment provenance or targeted hosted re-acceptance is recorded; finding remains open.

findings.title: Tickets takes about 11–14 seconds to show useful content
findings.summary: Hosted Tickets/Wallet loads were slow in some observed passes.
findings.expected_behavior: Ticket content is available promptly. Establish a measured baseline and performance target during the scheduled pass.
findings.observed_behavior: Some hosted passes took approximately 11–14 seconds to useful Tickets content.
findings.owner_decision: Route to Guest M5 performance work, outside the current Guest correctness remediation.

reacceptance.scope: Measure time to useful Tickets content and request counts with representative staging wallets. Recheck after performance changes against the agreed target.

findings.title: Host cannot select known availability at a partnered Venue
findings.summary: Host Create Event failed to expose an available partnered Venue window in the owner-observed staging case.
findings.expected_behavior: Eligible Hosts see and can select legitimate available windows for the partnered Venue and requested month.
findings.observed_behavior: Host Create Event showed No free time remains this month despite known legitimate available windows.

reacceptance.scope: Publish a disposable available window as the partnered Venue. Compare the Host calendar and editor in IST, select the window and submit the request.

findings.title: Venue Accept and Decline decisions are unreliable
findings.summary: Owner-observed staging decisions were unreliable, including a prior server error on Decline.
findings.expected_behavior: An authorized Venue can accept or decline an eligible request with an accurate response, consistent persisted states and the correct downstream handoff.
findings.observed_behavior: The owner observed unreliable Accept and Decline actions. A prior Decline returned HTTP 500.

reacceptance.scope: Use separate disposable requests for Accept and Decline. Check response, persisted request/slot states, Host visibility, event and applicable assignment behavior, then refresh and retry safely.

findings.notes: HA-035 records a historical partial Accept commit involving a Promoter assignment. It is related historical evidence. A shared cause with the current Accept/Decline failures remains unverified.
